gcp_gke_cluster_endpoint_publicly_access.summary: Disable the GKE cluster's public IP control-plane endpoint after confirming a working alternative administration path.
steps: Inspect controlPlaneEndpointsConfig.ipEndpointsConfig.enablePublicEndpoint on the affected cluster and identify the administrators and automation that currently use its public IP endpoint.
Plan and test an alternative path for cluster administration, such as internal IP access or a secured DNS endpoint, before disabling the public IP endpoint.
Apply the owner-approved endpoint configuration change, verify that administration still works, read back enablePublicEndpoint, then recollect and rerun the check.
caveats: Disabling the public IP endpoint can interrupt kubectl, CI jobs, and other control-plane clients until an alternative access path is ready.
This check measures only the public IP endpoint Boolean. The DNS endpoint has separate external-traffic controls and needs its own review.
